A.title: Lead-in + serif key phrase
A.description: A small sans lead-in "That is" sits under your chin and the key phrase "real protection" lands below it in a large warm italic serif, the way TXT-004 pairs a quiet line with a spaced serif phrase.
A.enter: The lead-in fades and rises in first; the serif phrase follows 0.3 s later with its blur clearing.
A.move: Nothing moves after landing: the phrase holds still while you say it.
A.exit: Both lines fade out together as the sentence ends.
A.sound: one soft texture as the serif phrase lands

B.title: Extended caps PROTECTION
B.description: One wide, tracked-out keyword PROTECTION in white caps with a thin "that is real" kicker above it, as in TXT-007's GROWTH caption.
B.enter: The kicker fades in; the caps word expands from tight to wide letter spacing while fading in.
B.move: The letter spacing keeps opening very slowly while it is on screen.
B.exit: The word and kicker fade out with a slight upward drift.
B.sound: a short airy whoosh under the letter-spacing expansion

C.title: Shield outline draws around the words
C.noReference: Your library has no shield, badge or outline-drawing caption, so there is no honest style example to show for this one.
C.description: "real protection" in bold sans under your chin while a thin shield outline draws itself around the two words, closing exactly as you finish the line.
C.enter: The words fade in; the shield outline starts drawing from the top point.
C.move: The outline traces both sides of the shield down to its point around the words.
C.exit: The outline and the words fade out together.
C.sound: a quiet rising texture while the outline draws, ending on a soft click
